programme.title: Licence d'Informatique - Faculté des Sciences et Ingénierie, Sorbonne Université
programme.degree: Licence (national bachelor's degree) mention Informatique, 3 years; L1 is a multidisciplinary integration year through a portail (Mathématiques et Informatique, or Électronique et Informatique), L2-L3 in the Licence d'Informatique; September start
programme.how_found: Official URL found by site search on sorbonne-universite.fr (discovery only): sciences.sorbonne-universite.fr -> Offre de formation -> Licences -> 'Les L2-L3 : nos huit disciplines de Licence' -> Licence d'Informatique.
programme.notes: French-taught (B2 French required for licence applicants). The row has no official_domain in kb_top100_list.json; sorbonne-universite.fr is Sorbonne University's official site. No English twin of the licence page was found.

english.quote: Un niveau B2 minimum en français est indispensable pour candidater au niveau licence à la faculté des Sciences et Ingénierie de Sorbonne Université
english.notes: Faculty of Science and Engineering, L1 applicants with a foreign diploma (non-European). Not an English requirement.

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published for L1 via the DAP (Etudes en France) route; selection on file.

deadline.quote: Les étudiantes et étudiants titulaires d’un diplôme étranger de fin d’études secondaires désireux de s’inscrire en 1re année de licence doivent impérativement faire une Demande d’Admission Préalable (DAP) entre le 1er octobre 2026 et le 15 janvier 2027 délai de rigueur
deadline.notes: Non-European holders of a foreign secondary diploma, L1 for the September 2027 start; via Etudes en France (Campus France countries) or the 'Dossier blanc' at the French embassy. Page updated 12/10/2026.

tuition.notes: Enrolment fees 2026/2027: 'Bachelor’s degree programmes: €178' (national rate, sorbonne-universite.fr/en/education/study-sorbonne-university/enrolment-procedures-and-tuition-fees). Non-EU students are in principle liable to the national differentiated fees, whose amount is not printed on the pages read; Sorbonne runs an exemption policy (committee decision on application, partial or total). No single published amount for an incoming non-EU applicant; 2027/28 not published.

scholarship_exists.notes: No Sorbonne University scholarship for incoming international licence students was found; only the exemption policy for differentiated fees (a fee waiver decided case by case) and state grants (CROUS / French Government) that exempt fees.
